messages:
Emily: starting RC creation for release-candidate v0.12.3 — aiming for quiet window at 18:00 PT. tagging build as rc-v0.12.3. Can folks please run quick smoke and telemetry checks?
Sasha: ack, will run smoke now. I can be on call for the promo. :thumbsup:
Mike: running smoke. saw one flaky test in embed-service locally, re-running.
Mike: smoke mostly green; embed-service test failed once but passed on retry. logs attached: `embed/test_integration.py::test_vector_upsert` flaked ~200ms timeout.
Emily: thanks. I pushed a nanofix (timeout bump) and re-triggered candidate build. deploybot, produce candidate rc-v0.12.3 from main at commit `a1b2c3d`
deploybot: Received request: create-candidate rc-v0.12.3 from `main@a1b2c3d`. Starting build.
deploybot: Build complete: rc-v0.12.3 (artifact sha: 9f8e7d). Staged to canary cluster. To promote to staging: `/deploy promote --artifact 9f8e7d --to staging --tags rc-v0.12.3`
Jon: telemetry quick check: p50/p95 stable, slight p99 bump on embed-service during canary spike (+120ms). No increase in error rate. Snapshot: `embed-service p99: 430ms -> 550ms` at spike.
Sasha: is the p99 bounce correlated with KV warm? I see increased cold-starts around the canary warmup window.
Mike: confirmed KV cache warmup triggered at 15:42. That explains transient p99. Investigating cache policy tweak.
Emily: decision: proceed with staged promotion but keep strict rollback guard. Plan: promote to staging now, run 30m telemetry, then promote to prod at 18:00 PT if no regressions. Rollback plan documented below.
Emily: Rollback plan summary: 1) If errors >0.5% or p99 latency > +200ms sustained 5m, trigger rollback. 2) Rollback command: `/deploy rollback --to artifact 0.12.2-9d8c7b --reason "rc-v0.12.3 regression"` 3) On-call: Sasha -> Mike -> Jon.
qa-bot: running regression suite (smoke + core-e2e). ETA 12 minutes.
deploybot: Promotion to staging requested by Emily: `/deploy promote --artifact 9f8e7d --to staging`
deploybot: Promotion succeeded. Staging instances: 6/6 up. Canary traffic: 3% routed.
Jon: running eval prompts now (sample prompts: billing, auth, long-context). No semantic regressions seen in 40 samples.
Sasha: monitoring dashboard pinned. Setting alerts: p50/p95/p99, error-rate, tail CPU on GPU nodes.
Mike: embedding test flake fixed by timeout tweak, adding a follow-up ticket to investigate root cause: TICKET-1425.
Emily: after 30m staging watch (ends ~17:42 PT) and no alerts, plan to open prod promo window at 18:00 PT. Can people confirm availability at push time?
Sasha: available.
Mike: available, will be on-call.
Jon: available for telemetry readout during promo.
deploybot: Standby reminder: scheduled promo window for rc-v0.12.3 at 18:00 PT. Use `/deploy promote --artifact 9f8e7d --to prod --tags rc-v0.12.3` to run.
Emily: final note — release notes draft is in docs/release-notes/v0.12.3.md, please add any user-visible changes before 17:30 PT. Also adding post-promo smoke checklist: verify KV hit-rate, model latency, embeddings correctness.
qa-bot: regression suite passed on staging. All checks green.
deploybot: Promotion to prod requested by Emily at 18:00 PT: `/deploy promote --artifact 9f8e7d --to prod --tags rc-v0.12.3`
deploybot: Prod deploy in progress: rolling deploy across 4 regions, max surge 10%.
deploybot: Prod deploy succeeded: all regions healthy. Traffic ramp completed.
Jon: telemetry quick readout: p50/p95 unchanged, p99 back to baseline. No error-rate increase.
Sasha: post-deploy sanity: embeddings smoke, auth flows, billing calls — all good. :white_check_mark:
Emily: closing thread — rc-v0.12.3 promoted to prod. Release notes published. If anyone observes regression, follow rollback plan and ping #eng-oncall. Thanks team!
